verified_loci: Personae (1909) — the title itself: the mask as authorial position
Cathay (1915) — translation as the making of a voice
Homage to Sextus Propertius, in Poems 1918-21 — the transform of a Latin source that Pound refused to call translation
why_seated: Pound is the middle term. Personae names the operation outright, and Homage to Sextus Propertius is the same manoeuvre Ginsberg later performs on Catullus 38: a Latin source whose form is tracked and whose register is inverted, defended by its author as something other than translation when the philologists complained. Seated so the Ginsberg/Catullus transform has a precedent inside the archive and the series Browning-Pound-Pessoa can be measured as one developing practice.
